snippet.title: INFERIUS | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
Descend into INFERIUS, a first-person horror roguelike deckbuilder inspired by Lovecraft and Dante's Inferno. Battle through nine dominions of Hell in turn-based Tarot card duels, ward off madness with your flailing lantern, and uncover the truth buried at the heart of damnation. Each run reshapes the Inferno, daring you to descend once more. 
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2470790/INFERIUS/
Lucid Rain Studios: https://lucidrainstudios.com
---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://store.thehorrorgameawards.com/
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/TheHorrorGameAwards

Discord: https://discord.gg/j8wUUzJQ8D

Instagram: https://instagram.com/thehorrorgameawards
